syllabus_topics: Analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog conversion: Rounding and sampling.
Filtering: Transfer function; Butterworth and Chebyshev approximations; RLC filters; 1st and 2nd order active filters.

Signal generation - Linear oscillators and Barkhausen criterion; Wien bridge oscillator; LC oscillators; Crystal oscillators; Gain control and stabilization of sinusoidal oscillators; Astable multivibrators; The 555 timer; VCO; PLL, Frequency synthesizers.
Communication system: constituent blocks of the PCM system.

Sensors and actuators: Characteristics (range, resolution; error; precision; linearity; sensitivity); Temperature, light, positioning, motion and sound sensors; Heat, light, force, positioning and motion, and sound actuators; Interface circuits for sensors and actuators.
Embedded systems: use of microcontrollers for actuation.
assessment_rules: The laboratory grade is calculated as (L1 + L2 + L3 + 2x L4 + L5) / 6, with a minimum grade of 9.5 values. The final grade in the "normal period" is 50% x Laboratory Grade + 50% x E-EN Exam, with a minimum of 8.0 values in the E-EN exam. The final grade in the "re-sit period" is 50% x Laboratory Grade + 50% x E-ER Exam, with a minimum of 8.0 values in the E-ER exam. Student workers can choose between the rules of the "normal period" or the "re-sit period". In the "special period", the final grade is 100% x Exam.
